provenance: Synthetic architectural baseline institution_enrichment.CLUBS at 4c176ccd; published directory entries, not student memberships.

clubs.name: Aster Robotics
clubs.description: Builds and competes with autonomous robots; open to every major.
clubs.longDescription: Weekly build sessions in the Innovation Hall makerspace, a first-year mentoring track, and two intercollegiate competitions a year. No experience needed.

clubs.name: Code Collective
clubs.description: Peer programming, hackathons and interview practice for Computing and Data Science students.
clubs.longDescription: Runs the autumn hackathon with the Career Center, weekly problem-solving sessions and a beginners' track aligned with CS 101.

clubs.name: Women in Business
clubs.description: Mentoring, speaker series and case competitions for students in Business and Accounting.
clubs.longDescription: Partners with the Department of Business on the spring case competition and runs a mentoring circle with alumnae.

clubs.name: Outdoor Aster
clubs.description: Day hikes, weekend trips and gear lending for students of every experience level.
clubs.longDescription: Runs a beginners' hike each Saturday of September and lends tents and packs from the Recreation Center.

clubs.name: International Students Association
clubs.description: Community, cultural nights and practical support for students from abroad and their friends.
clubs.longDescription: Works with International Student Services on check-in week, hosts the Global Village dinners in Fernhollow House and a monthly cultural night.

clubs.name: Aster Pre-Health Society
clubs.description: For Nursing, Biology and Chemistry students heading to health professions.
clubs.longDescription: Application workshops, shadowing placements arranged with the Department of Health Sciences, and the spring health-professions panel.

clubs.name: Design Collective
clubs.description: BFA Design students and anyone who makes things; runs the Fernhollow studio nights.
clubs.longDescription: Open studio nights in Fernhollow House, the spring student exhibition and portfolio reviews for internal-transfer applicants.

clubs.name: Economics Society
clubs.description: Debates, guest lectures and the annual policy competition for Social Sciences students.
clubs.longDescription: Hosts a faculty lecture each month and fields a team for the intercollegiate policy competition in March.

clubs.name: Aster Chamber Singers
clubs.description: Auditioned choir performing the Winter Concert and Commencement.
clubs.longDescription: Rehearses twice weekly; auditions in the first two weeks of each term.

clubs.name: Commuter Student Network
clubs.description: Support and space for students living off campus or with family.
clubs.longDescription: Commuter lounge in the Student Union, carpool matching and a voice on parking and shuttle matters through Student Life.

clubs.name: Transfer Student Alliance
clubs.description: Peer support for transfer students, from credit evaluation to finding a study group.
clubs.longDescription: Meets with the Transfer Success Advisers each term and runs the transfer mentor program launched at Transfer Orientation.

clubs.name: Aster Service Corps
clubs.description: Community service placements with local partners; counts towards Work-Study community service.
clubs.longDescription: Weekly placements at partner organisations and the Spring Festival service day.
